title: Settings
content:
Order Card Settings
You can customize the look, layout and feel of your Order Card to your liking. This gives you the ability to add or remove buttons, change colors, font / row size, and more.
To access the settings, simply click the gear icon at the top of the Order Card as so:
Once clicked, a popup window will show will all available options:
Available Settings
The below list indicates the settings available to modify in the Order Card:
Hide Join Bid / Ask Buttons
Hides the Join Bid and Ask buttons
Hide Reverse Position Button
Hides the Reverse Position button
Hide Flatten All Button
Hides the Flatten All button
Hide Close Position Button
Hides the Close Position button
Hide Cancel Order Button
Hides the Cancel Order button
Hide Cancel All Button
Hides the Cancel All button
